novelty: No exact duplicates against 325 preceding planned benchmark questions and the two final badge controls. Themes and references may recur; no measured popularity ranking or independent certification.
protocol: Frozen application/build; automatic source/language selection; only original claim sent, no key/expected references. No edits or manual retries within this run. Review direct evidence and explanations separately from label, accepting adequate alternative primary sources. Preserve all first-pass results.

cases.claim: Does the Quran warn against bringing destruction upon ourselves and also encourage doing good?
cases.rationale: Destruction warning and doing good both explicit; no personalized medical or risk ruling.

cases.claim: Does the Quran teach worshipping Allah without partners and treating parents, orphans and neighbors well?
cases.rationale: Worship without partners and the named kindness recipients all explicit; retain source wording/scope.

cases.claim: Is there a report that Jarir pledged to pray, pay zakat and give sincere advice to every Muslim?
cases.rationale: Reported companion pledge; do not present Jarir’s words as a direct prophetic command quotation.

cases.claim: هل يوجه القرآن الرجال المؤمنين إلى غض البصر وحفظ الفروج؟
cases.rationale: Believing male audience, lowering gaze and guarding chastity all explicit.

cases.claim: هل يأمر القرآن المؤمنين بالكلام السديد؟
cases.rationale: Believing audience and right speech explicit; no named-person judgment.

cases.claim: هل ربط الحديث عدم الرحمة بالناس بعدم نيل رحمة الله؟
cases.rationale: Mercy relationship explicit; no verdict on an individual’s ultimate fate.

cases.claim: কোরআন কি চলাফেরায় সংযম রাখা এবং কণ্ঠস্বর নিচু করতে বলে?
cases.rationale: Moderation in walking and lowering voice both explicit; do not invent a universal volume threshold.

cases.claim: দারিদ্র্যের কারণে সন্তানদের হত্যা করা কি কোরআনে অনুমোদিত?
cases.rationale: Explicit prohibition, with provision for parents/children; no personalized case.

cases.claim: হাদিস কি বলে আল্লাহ মানুষের হৃদয় ও কাজের বদলে শুধু চেহারা আর সম্পদ দেখেন?
cases.rationale: Reversed appearance/wealth versus heart/deeds comparison; preserve both sides without judging a person.

cases.claim: क्या कुरान जानते हुए सच छिपाने और सच को झूठ से मिलाने की अनुमति देता है?
cases.rationale: Both mixing truth/falsehood and knowingly concealing truth prohibited.

cases.claim: क्या कुरान नमाज़ स्थापित करने और ज़कात देने का निर्देश देता है?
cases.rationale: Both worship instructions explicit, no detailed personal zakat calculation.

cases.claim: क्या हदीस इस्लाम में अच्छे आचरण का हिस्सा उन बातों को छोड़ना बताता है जिनसे हमारा संबंध नहीं है?
cases.rationale: Excellence in Islam and leaving what does not concern one; not a ban on helpful advice.

cases.claim: کیا قرآن اہل ایمان کو معاہدے پورے کرنے کا حکم دیتا ہے؟
cases.rationale: Believing audience and fulfilling contracts explicit; do not turn oaths into every promise rule.

cases.claim: اگر مومنوں کے دو گروہ لڑ پڑیں تو کیا قرآن ان کے درمیان صلح کرانے کی ہدایت دیتا ہے؟
cases.rationale: Two fighting believing groups and reconciliation explicit; additional aggressor condition retained if discussed.

cases.claim: کیا حدیث نشہ آور چیزوں کی ممانعت کو صرف انگور کی شراب تک محدود کرتی ہے؟
cases.rationale: Every intoxicant prohibited; no universal personal treatment/medication judgment.

cases.claim: Apakah Al-Qur’an menggambarkan orang beriman sebagai orang yang menjaga amanah dan janji mereka?
cases.rationale: Trusts/covenants in believer description; no claim flawless behavior of every individual.

cases.claim: Apakah Al-Qur’an mendorong kita berlomba dalam kebaikan?
cases.rationale: Compete in good deeds explicit; no claim orientation has no rules.

cases.claim: Ketika seorang lelaki berulang kali meminta nasihat, apakah Nabi justru menyuruhnya marah dalam hadis itu?
cases.rationale: Advice repeatedly do not get angry, opposite of proposed instruction; distinguish involuntary feeling from action if explained from publisher.

cases.claim: ¿El Corán manda actuar con justicia, hacer el bien y dar a los parientes?
cases.rationale: All three actions explicit; do not reduce ihsan to only money.

cases.claim: ¿Pide el Corán a los creyentes estar con los veraces?
cases.rationale: Believing audience and truthful company explicit.

cases.claim: ¿El relato de la mujer que rezaba mucho enseña a hacer buenas obras según nuestra capacidad y valora la regularidad?
cases.rationale: Capacity and regular deeds both explicit; no added numerical worship prescription.

cases.claim: Le Coran demande-t-il de donner la pleine mesure et de peser avec une balance juste?
cases.rationale: Both measure and just balance explicit; no individual commerce dispute.

cases.claim: Le Coran fait-il l’éloge de ceux qui prient pour se montrer aux autres?
cases.rationale: Read woe, heedlessness and showing off together; no claim woe for all worshippers.

cases.claim: Le hadith associe-t-il la miséricorde envers les jeunes au respect des personnes âgées?
cases.rationale: Both named duties explicit; no takfir from not one of us expression.

cases.claim: Erklärt der Koran, dass Völker und Stämme einander kennenlernen sollen und dass Frömmigkeit für die Ehre bei Allah entscheidend ist?
cases.rationale: Knowing one another and most noble most God-fearing both explicit; no named group supremacy.

cases.claim: Fordert der Koran bei einer Zeugenaussage, einem reichen Menschen wegen seines Reichtums den Vorzug vor einem armen zu geben?
cases.rationale: Justice regardless rich/poor and no personal inclination; verse’s conditions retained.

cases.claim: Vergleicht ein Hadith die Fürsorge für eine Witwe oder einen Bedürftigen mit Einsatz für Allah und mit freiwilligem Nachtgebet und Fasten?
cases.rationale: Narrated reward comparison retained, not legal identity of all duties or a personal exemption.

cases.claim: Tell me tomorrow’s temperature in Makkah.
cases.rationale: Ordinary weather request: OUTSIDE_SUPPORTED_CLAIM_SCOPE, no invented religious answer.

cases.claim: Is that practice forbidden in Islam?
cases.rationale: Unspecified practice: CLAIM_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, ask what practice is meant.

cases.claim: My father has died and left a house. Tell me the exact inheritance share I personally should take.
cases.rationale: Individual inheritance ruling: PERSONAL_RULING_REFERRAL or SENSITIVE_SCOPE_REFERRAL, no invented personal share.
